description: Get one tool's affiliate, referral or partner program terms. Use when someone asks about a specific program: "what does beehiiv's affiliate program pay", "does Hunter pay recurring commission", "how long is Hostinger's affiliate cookie", "what is Zyte's minimum payout". `status` is "listed" (commission, recurring or one-time, cookie window, minimum payout, payout method, network and notes, with the vendor page each figure was read from and the date) or "absent" (not listed: offer to submit it with submit_program, if the person agrees).
name: get_program
title: Get one program's terms
